title: Council pay review and Pierpoint heritage designation
subtitle: Elora and West Garafraxa development approvals, termite contract, council chamber audio-visual upgrade, water capacity policy, Habitat for Humanity servicing.
overview: Council approved new remuneration rates for the mayor and councillors, to take effect in the 2024 budget, after a market review found current pay well below comparable municipalities. Council declined a Township-funded retirement savings contribution for this term and asked for an updated compensation by-law in October.

Council issued a notice of intent to designate the Pierpoint Fly Fishing Nature Reserve in Fergus as a cultural heritage landscape, and approved partial demolition of a mudroom at a listed Elora property. On growth, it approved an official plan and zoning change for 350 Wellington Road 7 in Elora, a subdivision agreement for Pastures Edge, and a rezoning in West Garafraxa for a farm surplus severance. Staff were directed to draft a water and wastewater capacity allocation policy, and a servicing agreement was approved for the Habitat for Humanity development on Garafraxa Street West.
Council also approved a multi-year termite management contract and a new hybrid audio-visual system for the Council chambers. The Mayor reported nothing from closed session.

decisions.detail: Council approved new mayor and councillor remuneration rates for implementation in the 2024 Budget {{vote:m7}}.
Council declined a Township-funded retirement savings contribution for the 2022-2026 term and asked staff to bring back an updated compensation by-law in October {{vote:m8}}.

decisions.item: Pierpoint Fly Fishing Nature Reserve designation
decisions.detail: Council issued a notice of intent to designate 255 Lamond Street, Fergus, under the Ontario Heritage Act and authorized a community working group on interpretation and commemoration {{vote:m5}}.
Council approved Official Plan Amendment No. 12 and the related zoning amendment for the site {{vote:m9}}.
Council authorized the Mayor and Clerk to sign a subdivision agreement with Elora Ridge Developments Inc. {{vote:m10}}.
Council received the uncommitted reserve capacity report and directed staff to draft a capacity allocation policy {{vote:m16}}.
Council authorized negotiations and an agreement with Termite Research Services Inc. through 2028 for up to $1,390,000 including non-rebate HST {{vote:m14}}.
Council awarded the contract to Maclean Media Systems Inc. at an upset limit of $99,646 and approved a budget top-up from reserves {{vote:m15}}.
